solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Wizard's fighting something hairy

parts.note: fighting between nations is war
a lock is a tress or tuft of hair

explanation.surface: A wizard is apparently battling some furry creature.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after 'Wizard' stands for 'is', joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A male practitioner of sorcery or black magic is called a warlock, a synonym for a wizard.

clue.text: Daughter grabbed by Bill in savage style

indicators.note: being grabbed by something means being held within it

parts.note: Willy is a familiar form of the name William, as is Bill

explanation.surface: A girl is seized by a man called Bill in a brutal manner.
explanation.definitionFit: To behave wildly is to behave in an uncontrolled, ferocious way.

clue.text: Improved, like a sofa given a makeover?

definitions.meaning: having got better after an illness

definitions.text: like a sofa given a makeover?
definitions.meaning: a sofa given new upholstery has had a fresh cover fitted

explanation.surface: Getting better is like reupholstering furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A patient who got well again has improved; a sofa fitted with new fabric is covered once more.

clue.text: Entertainment an agent set up, nothing superior

indicators.note: superior means placed above, so in this down entry it comes first

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: an is the article a
a rep is a sales representative, an agent

explanation.surface: A show staged by an agent, with nothing better on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' reverses A + REP to make PERA; 'superior' puts O above it in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Opera is a kind of staged musical drama, so a form of entertainment.

clue.text: Equipment given to revolutionary fiddler, loveless soldier

parts.note: kit is gear or equipment
Che Guevara was the Argentine-born revolutionary

indicators.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O, so loveless means it is removed

parts.note: Nero was said to have fiddled while Rome burned

explanation.surface: Gear handed to a radical violinist, a soldier with no love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loveless' removes O, since love is zero in tennis scoring. Kitchener was a British field marshal famous from the First World War recruiting poster.
explanation.definitionFit: Lord Kitchener was a celebrated British army commander, so a soldier.

clue.text: Person contributing to studies of the sun, engaging companion

indicators.note: to engage is to take something in, so the solar word holds the companion abbreviation

parts.note: solar means relating to the sun
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: Someone who studies the sun takes on a charming partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engaging' looks like an adjective meaning charming, but works as a verb meaning holding. Companion of Honour is a British order of merit.
explanation.definitionFit: A learned academic contributes research to a field of learning, which is what a scholar does.

clue.text: Father has fallen ultimately on account of temptress

parts.note: a sire is a father, especially of a horse

indicators.note: ultimately means at the end, so we take the final letter of the word fallen

explanation.surface: A father has lapsed morally because of a seductive woman.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth the Sirens lured sailors to ruin with song, so the word means a seductress.

clue.text: Condition of giddiness brought by powerful source of illumination

definitions.meaning: read whimsically as a head that feels light, the dizzy state of being light-headed
a bright lamp at the front of a car

explanation.surface: Feeling dizzy is caused by a dazzling light.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is playful: a 'light head' turned round as 'head light' is a giddy feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: A car's main front lamp is a strong beam; being dizzy is having a light feeling in the skull.

clue.text: Palaeontologist reportedly inclined to blab

indicators.note: reportedly means as spoken, so the surname is judged by its sound

parts.note: Louis or Richard Leakey, famous fossil hunters in East Africa

explanation.surface: A fossil expert is said to be prone to gossip.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone leaky lets secrets out, so they are given to blabbing.

clue.text: Criminal hustlers without mercy

indicators.note: criminal suggests something wrong or crooked, so the letters are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: Crooked swindlers who show no pity.
explanation.definitionFit: Being pitiless and showing no compassion is what ruthless means.

clue.text: Endless good fortune, about to get money

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the word for good fortune is cut off

parts.note: good fortune is luck
re means about or concerning, as in business letters

explanation.surface: A run of luck that never stops, about to bring in cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucre is a disparaging word for money, as in 'filthy lucre'.

clue.text: Severed pile of rocks, pile constructed with skill

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill or heap of rocks, typical of Dartmoor
pile is the raised surface of fabric, also called nap
art means skill, as in 'the art of persuasion'

explanation.surface: Something split apart, a heap of stones, and a carefully built heap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pile' appears twice in two senses: a heap (TOR) and the soft surface of cloth (NAP). A TOR is a rocky hilltop, common on Dartmoor in England.
explanation.definitionFit: Something severed has been ripped into pieces, which is the phrase's meaning.

clue.text: He, valiant, destroyed monster

indicators.note: destroyed tells us the letters of the two words are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A brave hero has slain a monster.
explanation.definitionFit: The Leviathan is a huge sea monster of the Bible, and the word now means any monster.

clue.text: See American university with no room for English? True!

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see

indicators.note: having no room for something means it is shut out, so the letter is taken away

parts.note: Yale is a university in Connecticut

explanation.surface: Look at an American university that excludes the English — that's a fact!
explanation.definitionFit: True in the sense of faithful or steadfast, as a true friend is a loyal one.

clue.text: Grim colonist is troubling law- violation experts

indicators.note: troubling suggests disturbing the letters, so the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dour settler is bothering the people who study lawbreaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Criminologists are specialists who study crime, that is, the breaking of the law.

clue.text: Funny type endless involved in moneymaking enterprise, a bad guy

indicators.note: involved in means wrapped up inside another word

parts.note: a mint makes coins, and is also a source of great wealth

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the word for a comedian is dropped

parts.note: a scream is a hilarious person

explanation.surface: A comic with no end, caught up in a business, turns out to be the villain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Funny type' suggests a clown or wit; the word needed is the slang for a hilarious person, which then loses its tail.
explanation.definitionFit: A miscreant is a wrongdoer or villain, the same as a bad guy.

clue.text: There's a complicated network thy brain will ultimately fire off

indicators.note: ultimately means at the end, so the final letter of the word will
to fire off is to discharge wildly, so the letters are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: Your mind will eventually shoot off into a tangled web.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimately' takes L from 'will', and 'fire off' mixes that L in with THY BRAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A labyrinth is a maze, an intricate network of passages.

clue.text: Hang around, lying in grass, kissing and cuddling

indicators.note: lying in means resting inside another word

parts.note: to grass is British slang for informing on someone, also to sing
to mooch is to loiter aimlessly

explanation.surface: Loitering, lying in the grass, and canoodling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grass' is not lawn but British slang for informing to the police, as is 'sing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Smooching is an informal word for amorous kissing and cuddling.

clue.text: Angry pub — this member is horizontal

parts.note: cross means annoyed or angry
a bar is a pub or a drinking place

explanation.surface: An irate pub where a regular is lying flat out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'member' suggests a club regular, and 'horizontal' a drunk lying down; really it is a structural part.
explanation.definitionFit: A crossbar is a beam set level across uprights, as on goalposts or a bicycle.

clue.text: Our dirtiest bin is unseemly in new allotment

indicators.note: something unseemly is improper or out of order, so the letters are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A filthy rubbish bin looks out of place on a freshly assigned garden plot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'allotment' suggests a British garden plot, but here it means the act of sharing out.
explanation.definitionFit: Redistribution is the sharing out of something again, a fresh allocation.

clue.text: Emblem on one sort of vessel

parts.note: a flag is a national emblem or banner

explanation.surface: A badge fixed to a kind of ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' suggests a boat, but here it is a container for drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A flagon is a large jug or bottle for wine or ale, a kind of drinking container.

clue.text: Concession with soldiers getting very deep sleep

parts.note: a sop is something offered to placate, a concession
OR stands for Other Ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A deal made with troops that lets them sleep soundly.
explanation.definitionFit: Sopor is a medical term for an unnaturally deep sleep or stupor.

clue.text: Plan to go round Italy — guide needed

indicators.note: to go round means the word for a plan surrounds the next piece

parts.note: a plot is a scheme or plan
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: Planning a tour of Italy needs a guide.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot steers a ship into harbour, so to pilot or a pilot is to guide or a guide.

clue.text: One vile creature in charge in China, behaving in criminal fashion

indicators.note: in shows the other pieces placed inside the word for a friend

parts.note: china is rhyming slang for mate (china plate), so a pal
one is the Roman numeral I
a rat is a despised creature

explanation.surface: A nasty person in authority in China acts like a crook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country but is rhyming slang: china plate = mate, giving PAL. Rhyming slang is a London custom of replacing a word with a phrase that rhymes with it.
explanation.definitionFit: Piratical describes acting like a pirate, a robber on the high seas, so lawlessly.

clue.text: Was nosy — a sin, from what we hear

indicators.note: from what we hear means the word is taken by sound alone

parts.note: pride is one of the seven deadly sins

explanation.surface: Prying is said to be a sin.
explanation.definitionFit: To have pried is to have poked into others' affairs, which is being nosy.

clue.text: Parking area set up in which we will get drier

indicators.note: in which shows the next word placed inside the reversed word
in a down clue set up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: a lot is a car park, a parking lot

explanation.surface: A car park built where we will end up drier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drier' looks like an adjective (less wet) but is a noun: a thing that dries. 'set up' reads the parking word upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A towel is a cloth used to dry yourself, so a thing that dries.

clue.text: Prominence endlessly pursued by heretic from European country

indicators.note: pursued by means the heretic comes after, following behind
endlessly means the final letter of the word for a prominence is dropped

parts.note: a bulge is a protuberance or prominence
an Arian followed Arius, who denied the full divinity of Christ

explanation.surface: A noted figure keeps being chased by a dissenter from some European land.
explanation.definitionFit: Bulgarian is the adjective for Bulgaria, a country in south-east Europe.

clue.text: Distress call being heard

indicators.note: being heard means the word is judged by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: to ring is to call on the telephone

explanation.surface: An emergency signal is picked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Distress call' reads as one phrase, a mayday, but 'Distress' is the definition and 'call' the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To wring is to torment or pain, as in a story that wrings the heart.

clue.text: Nonsense a young lout spun

parts.note: rot means rubbish or nonsense
a Ted, short for Teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth known for rowdy behaviour

explanation.surface: A rowdy youth spins a yarn full of nonsense.
explanation.walkthrough: A Teddy boy (Ted) was a 1950s British youth in Edwardian-style dress, often seen as a hooligan.
explanation.definitionFit: Something spun has been turned round on an axis, which is a synonym.

clue.text: Element showing sign of holiness and knowledge

parts.note: a halo is the ring of light shown round a saint's head
gen is British slang for information or knowledge

explanation.surface: A chemical element that shows saintliness and wisdom.
explanation.definitionFit: Halogens are the group of chemical elements including fluorine, chlorine and iodine; the word names any of them.
